dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Patience, patience... This is just a test of my patience...

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: As the director of the Fishing Association, I must remain by my post here at the fishing point — I shall defeat these Linebreakers with my unbending will!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Never mind that for now. I'd like to purchase some fishing supplies.

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Oh sure, of course! Take your pick!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: I'm the current director of the Fontaine Fishing Association, Delaroche! If you have any questions about fishing, you can come to me!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Ah, but I refer to fishing equipment and material. As for techniques, tips, and tricks, I shall not haphazardly instruct others.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You really did bring a weapon!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's right! I asked a friend at the Adventurers' Guild to procure it. Apparently, it's a foreign model...

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: While it's not as elegant to use as pistolets, it's simple, cheap, and easy to maintain.

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: O strange aquatic creature, you'd better pray I don't catch you. Otherwise, special treatment shall be in order!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I shan't bother you, then.

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait. Did you ask me something? Sorry, I didn't notice you there — I won't do that again, trust me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's your recent catches been?

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Ah! The God of Victorious Linebreaking! We meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: I've been steadily improving my bait recently, and think I've come a long way. I've even caught several... somewhat larger fish!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: I still don't think I've managed to create the ideal bait, however, so I don't have anything to give you...

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: But please, don't worry! At this rate, I know I'll be able to recreate that wonderful bait sooner or later!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the haul?

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Why, hello there! Thanks for your concern!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: As you can see, I'm having a hard time with these Linebreakers, these fighters who dwell underwater. I haven't really had much success yet.

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: But so long as I keep my head down and keep at it, believe me, I shall eventually earn my victory!
